Radboudumc Radiology | 19 February 2025 | mpMRI Prostate

Indication: Follow-up assessment for previously diagnosed prostate carcinoma; active PSA stands at 5.0 ng/mL.

FINDINGS: Glandular volume registers at 35.45 mL. A 12-millimeter focus occupies the posterior peripheral zone of the right mid-gland. T2 sequences reveal a hypointense area with blurred boundaries. Diffusion-weighted imaging shows pronounced restriction alongside correspondingly suppressed ADC values. Contrast-enhanced sequences capture early, localized enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. Staging confirms absence of extraprostatic extension and seminal vesicle involvement. Pelvic lymphadenopathy is absent.

IMPRESSION: Right mid-gland posterior peripheral zone demonstrates a PI-RADS 4 lesion. Calculated prostate-specific antigen density rests at 0.141 ng/mL/mL. csPCa probability: 0.7376658

previous_notes.author: Dr. M. Jansen (GP)
previous_notes.text: Entry dated 02 March 2023 documents a primary care follow-up following a July 2022 serum reading of 3.8 ng/mL. Because of the previously documented positive biopsy and the steady climb in serum markers, arrangements were made to transfer the patient to the urology outpatient department for a thorough clinical reassessment.
